statement: If any span of the semantic unit's source is UNACCOUNTED_SOURCE, or any quantitative value in it is unaccounted, then the inventory cannot be INVENTORY_OK in the completeness sense, reconciliation cannot report semanticallyComplete, and the agreement rollup cannot report SEMANTICALLY_COMPLETE.

enforcementPoints.mechanism: the coverage verdict is decided before every other status branch; any residue yields INVENTORY_COVERAGE_GAP
semanticallyComplete requires unaccountedSource.length === 0 AND uninventoriedValues.length === 0, checked against the lists themselves
enforcementPoints.independentOf: the inventory status string - a tampered INVENTORY_OK still fails

enforcementPoints.mechanism: SEMANTIC_INVENTORY_COVERAGE_GAP is raised from the status OR from a non-empty unaccountedSource, each span reported with its excerpt and reason
unchanged by this mission - a null or incomplete accountability result becomes REVIEW_REQUIRED, never SEMANTICALLY_COMPLETE

noSingleStringOfTruth: No enforcement point reads another's verdict. Tests tamper with the status string and with the residual list separately and confirm each refusal independently.
freezeBinding: unaccounted spans are part of frozenContentHash, so a gap cannot be edited out of a frozen inventory without changing its hash
materialityHonesty: Mission §15 - the detector never claims to know whether omitted text is material. UNACCOUNTED_SOURCE is review-blocking by default and is described in every reason string as 'materiality undetermined, never assumed immaterial'.
